sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 141)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American and British networks, Frank Lovejoy in John D. MacDonald's noir thriller *Your Grandfather's Necktie* on CBS *Escape*, Bette Davis starring in W. Somerset Maugham's *The Letter* on *Your Radio Theater*, two classic Klondike adventures with Paul Sutton as Sergeant Preston on *Challenge of the Yukon* for Quaker Cereals, Nicholas Parsons refereeing *Just a Minute* on BBC Radio 4, and Jone Allison in *Hearts in Harmony* for Kroger (1943–2002):
